title: King Charles' 'critical issue' with Harry and Meghan 'remains' after Highgrove reunion - AOL
snippet: Taylor Swift gives first glimpse of her wedding ring after ceremony 'weirded guests out' Meghan and Harry face 'serious problem of survival' after Prince
extractedText: King Charles' 'critical issue' with Harry and Meghan 'remains' after Highgrove reunionKathryn Ingate, Hollie BealeUpdated Sun, July 12, 2026 at 9:53 PM UTC0Prince Harry at the Invictus 1 Year To Go Event in Birmingham (Image: Getty)Buckingham Palace has confirmed that King Charles, 77, and Queen Camilla, 78, welcomed Prince Harry, 41, Meghan Markle, 44, and their two children, Prince Archie, seven, and Princess Lilibet, five, at Highgrove House on Friday.The Palace characterized the gathering at the King's Gloucestershire estate as a "private family occasion".The meeting marks the first time the monarch has seen Archie and Lilibet in over four years, while Meghan and Harry had not visited the UK together since 2022, when they attended Queen Elizabeth II's funeral.William and Kate 'send Prince Harry a clear message' post King Charles reunionMeghan and Harry face 'serious problem of survival' after Prince William moveRoyal commentator Jennie Bond, however, has indicated that one outstanding matter continues to cast a shadow over the relationship between the Sussexes and the King.In The i Paper, Jennie described the weekend as a potential "make-or-finally-break moment" between Harry and his father.The BBC's former royal correspondent further argued that a "lack of trust" remains the primary obstacle between Harry and the King, stemming from the couple's decision in 2020 to leave the UK and abandon their royal responsibilities to move to America.The situation became more fraught when Harry publicly voiced his complaints against his family, both in his Netflix documentary with Meghan and in his revealing memoir, Spare.Jennie wrote just before the reunion was officially confirmed by the Palace: "Their end-of-term report would surely read: 'Must do better.' Trust - or rather a lack of it - between the two camps is still a critical issue.AdvertisementWilliam and Harry are not expected to reconcile any time soon (Image: Getty)"This weekend could be a make-or-finally-break moment in the chequered relationship between Harry and his dad."Despite these apparently positive signs between Harry and Charles, there are understood to be no arrangements for the Duke of Sussex to meet with his brother, Prince William, while he and Meghan are in the UK.Jennie also took the chance to praise the late Princess Diana's family for "executing a masterclass in diplomacy" in maintaining a solid relationship with both of her sons, Harry and William, despite their acrimonious rift.She continued: "Quietly, and without fuss, they have held true to Earl Spencer's pledge at Diana's funeral to protect William and Harry and allow 'their souls to sing openly' as she had planned."Of course, it has to be said that the Spencers weren't in Harry's firing line during his onslaught against the Palace, his father, his brother, and others. So they have no reason to hold any grudges."They have executed a masterclass in diplomacy, staying on good terms with both brothers and showing up for Harry - for example, at the 10th anniversary of the Invictus Games a couple of years ago, when the royals shunned him."Get all the latest news, entertainment, sport and lifestyle updates from our dedicated American team.Sign up for our newsletters HERE.
